If all your data sits on one machine and it fails, you're down, and you may have lost data for good. That's unacceptable for anything important. So we replicate live copies of the data on several machines. One is the leader and takes the rights, and the followers copy every change. If the leader dies, the system notices and promotes a follower to be the new leader. That's failover and traffic reroutes on its own often within seconds. The copies off-- On...
